title: Mielle expands into body care with Daily Glow collection for melanin-rich skin
summary: Mielle, the Black-founded beauty textured hair care brand acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2023, is entering the body care market with Daily Glow, its first-ever collection developed with the needs of melanin-rich skin in mind. Launched on Amazon during the week of November 23, 2026, the seven-product range targets uneven skin tone, texture and the appearance of dark spots.
